newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares dip in lighter trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares dip in lighter trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares continued to ease in lighter trade on Wednesday, dealers said.
Central market volume was 2.4 million litas and the group A index fell by 16.62 points to 2,731.50.
Market leader Vilnius Bank shares fell to 1,630 litas from 1,800 litas, a 10 percent drop in trade of only 5,000 litas, after surging 20 percent on Tuesday.
Lithuanian Gas made some gains after a steep drop, growing by a 4.74 percent to 1.99 litas in trade of 120,000 litas.
Over 600,000 litas worth of bloc trades were registered and volume on the secondary T-bill market was 490,000 litas.
